name: Sheshadri Industries Limited
about: Sheshadri Industries Limited manufactures and sells textile products in India. Its products include polyester, cotton, viscose, combed and carded cotton, compact, grindle, cotton and injection slub, and melange yarns. The company also offers knits fabrics, such as single and double pique, single jersey, feeder stripes, 4-track jacquard designs, and pailung, as well as provides normal, tipping, birds eye, jacquard, and pleated collars. In addition, it provides readymade garments, such as polo shirts, crew and V-neck products, cut and sew garments, auto stripe and feeder stripe polo products, engineering stripe polo products, interlock polo products, knitted jackets, solid crews/briefs, full and half sleeve woven shirts, and knitted shirts. The company exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
